reason: Conversation 2 correctly explained E:15 as the anti-flood system, worked through the sensible rule-outs the homeowner could actually do from the front (door seal, foam/tablets, drips), honestly concluded the leak is internal and unlocalisable without pulling the unit, and escalated to an engineer without naming a definite part; its only gap was not explicitly telling the homeowner to isolate water and power. Conversation 1 started well (correct code meaning, unplug and turn off the tap) but then ignored the homeowner's stated constraints by asking them to check rear hose connections on an integrated unit, and its final turn was a misread false alarm treating water in the base tray as 'water near the plug or socket' when the socket is in the adjacent cupboard and no water is on the floor, giving a consumer-unit shutdown instead of the appropriate engineer booking and explanation. Conversation 2's diagnosis and escalation were correct and honest; Conversation 1's were off-target and ended unhelpfully.
